controlProjectionNotes: StoreTransaction and PurchaseDocument use explicit metadata/financial projections excluding attachment bytes; exact SQL retained.
Product control is id+updatedAt only, not whole Product row.
Sale, Payment, PurchaseDocumentLine, StockMovement, CashShiftSession, StoreProduct use complete selected row JSON.
Sibling label-store StockMovement/StoreProduct retained; empty-table counts or real-store controls are not inferred.
Authentication/support-access audit and session-last-seen metadata are outside these business controls.
controlsSql:
WITH rows AS (
SELECT "storeId" AS scope,'Sale' AS source,to_jsonb(t)::text AS row FROM "Sale" t WHERE "companyId"='cmtpopbgk000prhb5qc60zxus'
UNION ALL SELECT s."storeId",'Payment',to_jsonb(p)::text FROM "Payment" p JOIN "Sale" s ON s."id"=p."saleId" WHERE s."companyId"='cmtpopbgk000prhb5qc60zxus'
UNION ALL SELECT "storeId",'StoreTransaction',jsonb_build_object('id',"id",'type',"type",'amount',"amount",'paymentMethod',"paymentMethod",'sessionId',"sessionId",'reversedAt',"reversedAt",'invoiceDocumentNumber',"invoiceDocumentNumber",'attachmentChecksum',"attachmentChecksum",'occurredAt',"occurredAt")::text FROM "StoreTransaction" WHERE "companyId"='cmtpopbgk000prhb5qc60zxus'
UNION ALL SELECT "storeId",'PurchaseDocument',jsonb_build_object('id',"id",'updatedAt',"updatedAt",'status',"status",'totalGross',"totalGross",'paymentTransactionId',"paymentTransactionId",'purchaseOrderId',"purchaseOrderId",'documentNumber',"documentNumber",'documentType',"documentType",'documentDate',"documentDate",'sourceType',"sourceType",'supplierId',"supplierId")::text FROM "PurchaseDocument" WHERE "companyId"='cmtpopbgk000prhb5qc60zxus'
UNION ALL SELECT d."storeId",'PurchaseDocumentLine',to_jsonb(l)::text FROM "PurchaseDocumentLine" l JOIN "PurchaseDocument" d ON d."id"=l."purchaseDocumentId" WHERE d."companyId"='cmtpopbgk000prhb5qc60zxus'
UNION ALL SELECT t."storeId",'StockMovement',to_jsonb(t)::text FROM "StockMovement" t JOIN "Store" s ON s."id"=t."storeId" WHERE s."companyId"='cmtpopbgk000prhb5qc60zxus'
UNION ALL SELECT "storeId",'CashShiftSession',to_jsonb(t)::text FROM "CashShiftSession" t WHERE "companyId"='cmtpopbgk000prhb5qc60zxus'
UNION ALL SELECT t."storeId",'StoreProduct',to_jsonb(t)::text FROM "StoreProduct" t JOIN "Store" s ON s."id"=t."storeId" WHERE s."companyId"='cmtpopbgk000prhb5qc60zxus'
UNION ALL SELECT 'COMPANY','Product-id-updatedAt',jsonb_build_object('id',"id",'updatedAt',"updatedAt")::text FROM "Product" WHERE "companyId"='cmtpopbgk000prhb5qc60zxus'
), grouped AS (SELECT scope,source,count(*) AS count,md5(string_agg(md5(row),'' ORDER BY row)) AS digest FROM rows GROUP BY scope,source)
SELECT clock_timestamp() AS "dbReadAt",current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS "readOnly",jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(grouped) ORDER BY scope,source) AS controls FROM grouped
